description: This file defines an internal interface and a sealed class for handling gateway notifications in Orleans. It includes methods for stopping message sending to gateways and retrieving observer instances.

classes.name: ClientGatewayObserver
classes.description: Handles gateway notification events and manages observer identities.

methods.name: StopSendingToGateway
methods.description: Signals a client to stop sending messages to a specified gateway.

methods.name: GetObserverGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves the observer grain ID for a given client ID.

methods.name: GetObserver
methods.description: Retrieves an observer instance for a client using the grain factory.
